title: config-digger skill manager definition
description: How a skill manager lays out the skills it installs.

format_version.description: The version of this file format. Must be 1.

detectors.description:
What tells a skill folder it installed apart. A folder is the
manager's when any detector matches; across managers, the strongest
match wins, then the first manager loaded.

name.description: The display name, such as `npx skills`.

Detector.description: One sign that a skill folder was installed by the manager.

oneOf.description: The skill folder is a link or junction whose target matches a glob.

glob.description:
A `/`-separated glob matched against the last folder names of the
target, such as `.agents/skills/*`; `*` and `?` stay within one
name. Compared case-insensitively.

oneOf.description: The skill folder holds a file the manager writes into each copy.
The skill folder's own location matches a glob.

glob.description:
A `/`-separated glob matched against the last folder names of the
skill folder's path, as in `link-target-glob`.

oneOf.description: A JSON lock file of the manager has a key named like the skill folder.

file.description:
The lock file: a path starting with `~/` or `%NAME%`, or one
relative to the skill folder, such as `../../skills-lock.json`.

key_path.description: The key path of the object whose keys are skills.

sanitize.description: How the manager turns a key into a folder name, if it does.

scope.description:
The id of the Scope whose skills the lock file covers, such as
`user` or `project`, compared with the Scope its Agent definition
gives the skill folder's location. Without it, the lock file covers
skills in every Scope.

Strength.description: How much a detector's match says about who installed a folder.

oneOf.description:
A folder made by hand can match it too, such as one named like a
skill in the manager's lock file: the Entry gets a
`provenance_by_name_only` note.
Only the manager leaves it, such as its marker file.

KeySanitize.description: How a skill manager turns a lock file key into a folder name.

oneOf.description:
Lower case, each run of characters other than `a`-`z`, `0`-`9`, `.`
and `_` replaced by one `-`, with no `.` or `-` at either end, as
`npx skills` names folders.

Unverified.description: Facts of this table taken from inference, or defaults taken because a fact is not known, rather than from docs, disk or an experiment: a sentence saying what is assumed, or a list of them, which the release gate has to test. A fact whose test needs an account or a deployment the project does not have is under the release gate's exception: its mark is a table of the `sentence` and what the test `needs`, which the release gate lets ship and the release notes list. It changes nothing the definition does.
